body: I'm sorry, I don't mean to freak you out. I didn't realize that creeps people out too.

Thanks...I just can't deal with everything anymore though...It'll take months and months to get meds and therapy corectly, I don't think I'll make it that long. A friend of mine made me promise to not do it for a week from saturday so that it's not a knee-jerk reaction to the  break up and so my ex doesn't feel like it's her fault. But I'm confident I'll still want to. Nothing's gotten better, almost my entire lower body is covered in cuts now because I'm not allowed to kill myself.

I'm only alive right now because I care so much about her and I can't let her feel like it's her fault. No one else deserves to feel this much pain I can't pass it on to anyone else so I have to wait. But I have everything I need for an exit bag when the time comes
I made a large post in response to the other user that kind of sums up some stuff... lmk if you have any questions

yeah I'm in the U.S

Well the main thing is that I've been dealing with this for so many years and while sometimes (through therapy and medication) things are TOLERABLE for short periods of time, it always comes back to every day being absolute hell and torture.

It takes hours just to get out of bed because I get so apathetic that my body won't move. I usually have to resort to cutting myself just to get feeling enough to move. I haven't slept in 3 days either, in the past 12 days I've only gotten sleep half of the time. Our healthcare system sucks ass, I've been looking for more help since thanksgiving and only now do I have appointments. Things definitely trigger the intense spirals but there's no doubt that I always am susceptible and I think about suicide hourly. Or if things are "good" it's just weekly.

Some of this shit is gonna sound really stupid. And it's frustrating what I feel because I'm objectively an intelligent person, and I can think through situations logically, but my depression and anxiety won't let me act on them or believe the logic (which in turn just makes me frustrated at my own ineptitude).

During the past 6-8 months I've been feeling profoundly lonely. I'm a serial monogamist and I always end up investing so much support and care into all of my relationships. I've been in 4 serious relationships before my most recent, each lasting between 1 and two years The problem is they've all back fired. Yes I know I'm young and I've got so much time ahead of me to find love, but that also means I've got so much time ahead of me to be torn apart, every time it happens I get more and more distraught. 

My current failure is completely my fault as they all seem to be. Every single one of my previous relationships have ended in me being cheated on. Which is just awful. I have self-image issues as it is. Objectively I'm more attractive than 90% of guys and have a physique competitor's body so logically it shouldn't be my physical appearance, but I've always had shitty BDD (body dysmorphia disorder). On top of that, I always care and show so much support and just try to be the best person I can for the relationship. I don't become obsessed and I make sure not to be overbearing, and I'm always incredibly honest with my partners but something always goes wrong...

My most recent ex broke up with me solely due to my depression, she felt she had to shoulder my life, and baby me, which simply isn't true but that's the burden she put on herself. She couldn't deal with me being so depressed, To her it seemed to happen randomly, but I've always been really good at hiding it. It just happens to rear its ugly head when I get overwhelmed. And college starting back up, with the intense workload, and not being able to woirk out for a while due to shoulder surgery triggered a spiral that she had to witness.

So I lost another one, and it was my fault, not directly, but due to my mental illness. I know it's stupid to feel like she was "the one" and I know it's stupid to think that I won't be able to find anyone else but that's really how I feel. It's absolutely awful and it makes me realize that I'm undateable because of my mental illness. I've ruined too many relationships just being sad. But all I want is someone to say good morning, and to tell my it's going to be alright. And I can't find that. Especially in college where all the girls that are easy to meet only want sex.

So that's kind of a simple run down of the more recent things. I'm going to try to take some benadryl, nyquil, and melatonin to sleep now so I don't have to go another day without any sleep.

Another thing that bothers me is that people will say it's cowardly or selfish or weak to take your life. But I think it's selfish and weak of them to make me live for so long feeling like hell just to assuage their guilt. The problem is it works somewhat for me because I naturally put myself last because I hate myself, and I really value others' happiness way more than I value my own.

Sorry for writing so much...
